t: YBST ETF Stock Price & Overview
s: The GraniteShares YieldBoost Single Stock Universe ETF (YBST) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in total market equity. The fund is an actively managed fund-of-funds that invests in affiliated YieldBOOST ETFs. The underlying ETFs seek to provide current income and capped gains on select securities through a put option writing strategy.
